reviews.text:
Great service from the team here at Lordswood Vet (Manor vet). I had mixed up my appointment date (baby brain), and I desperately needed my Sherlock seen to for his worming & advocate spot on before my baby arrives in a few weeks.

Vicky and team were able to squeeze me impromptu, they answered all my questions and even offered some pointers for how to handle a new born and an anxious 9 year old chi.

Dave my vet was super kind and thoughtful also.
We usually go to manor vets northfield but staff very friendly nice and clean
Thanks for the review.  Please feel free to let us know if you feel we can improve the service we offer.
Friendly staff,Steve on reception is lovely friendly and happy,I bring my cat in and we always book in with Cat the vet,she is lovely with Mitzy very nice person and very good with my cat

Unfortunately I had a health visit with my beloved cat chimney in march 2025, where the vet Morgan Robinson failed to communicate to me that chimney had feline odontoclastic resorptive lesions (FORL) a painful dental issue.
It has since become apparent that
Vet Robinson wrote the following in chimneys medical history
"mild gingivitis around few remaining teeth - FORL present on 207/108"
"Disc FORL and monitoring dental disease "  was also written
There was no discussion and I was not informed about FORL
I was allowed to leave the practice believing chimney was in acceptable health .
Passive treatment is not an option for a cat with FORL, feline odontoclastic resorptive lesions .
Vet Morgan Robinson remarked that chimney had lost his teeth , this is a medical red flag.
I asked  "is there anything I can do about it " (the tooth loss)
Her response was a dismissive headshake . The correct professional response to my question should have been"we need to find out why" taking x-rays  should have been strongly recommended , with a dental management plan .( this information was not communicated to me)
Logging FORL, gingivitis, few remaining teeth, in the clinical history but failing to disclose this is a severe breach of professional conduct, and duty of care, a direct compromise to the welfare of chimney by Morgan Robinson .
Kat was amazing and really thorough and caring thank you
Friendly staff, no problem getting an appointment, vet explained everything well and did a thougher examination. I always get good information here.
Very nice ppl and was very good with my cat  took care with him.
My cats and I have been using  this vets for many years. The service is great, and the staff are very friendly and caring.

Every single time I come here we are seen extremely late - sometimes 30/40 minutes. There is always an excuse that something unexpected has happened but it seems to happen every visit. With a stressed animal this isn't acceptable and I would advise going to a different vet.

We have recently joined this vets practice to get our kitten “Noah” castrated, however on waiting for his appointment Noah recieved an injury to his neck and developed a swollen eye, I rang the practice and they fit us in the same day, the vet was a lovely young lady, it was clear to see she has a passion for animals and was very gentle and tentative towards Noah gave him a thorough inspection complete with medication, pricing wise I found it to be very fair, this has given me peace of mind that when Noah goes in for his op he will be in VERY good hands and that is good to know. Thankyou so much from both Noah and myself ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Professional and helpful and friendly staff.  Nice clean premises with a designated area to keep cats that are waiting to be examined separate from where pet dogs would be waiting.

I’ve been to a few veterinary practises and, this one is my favourite by far.

All of the staff are really warm, patient and understanding.

All checkups are smooth, really calm and always easy.

They were amazing when I was in a panic because my cat had a complication with a surgery (not their fault) and helped me through that, reassuring me and checking him over where appropriate.

Thank you Manor Harbourne team, you really made a big difference for me and Salem :)

My dog senior Jasper was seen by Lewis, a kind, patient and caring vet. He had a thorough examination including, heart; eyes, ears and anal glands. The vet listened to all my concerns and treated them seriously. The vet called upon a nurse to assist me when I could no longer hold on to Jasper safely during the examination process.
All staff, at the practice are highly professional including the frontline reception staff. I have been using Manor Vets for over 30 years and wouldn't go anywhere else.
Many thanks for the 5* review
Thanks for the 5* review, much appreciated

Whether is an emergency or a routine, the staff here is always on top. All the vets are very knowledgeable, friendly and attentive. Loki might not like going to the vets but he always receives a warm welcome and the support he needs. 🐶🐾

Receptionists are rude, vets are okay depending on who you get. Do NOT sign up to Pet Health Club because they do not care to ensure your pet actually gets the benefits you’re entitled to. I was told my dog would receive the flea, tick and mite treatment (a benefit of the plan) at his next appointment. This didn’t happen and now that I have an issue with this I’m being told it’s my responsibility to make sure he gets all the benefits? Last time I checked a client isn’t supposed to remind a vet of something that should have been written down in my dog’s notes. I am not a vet. My dog now has an ear infection due to them not bothering to ever administer it. Don’t bother formally complaining either- they’ll send you a sarcastic response blaming you for not ‘reading the T&Cs’. Now that I’ve paid hundreds of pounds in monthly fees, I’m apparently not entitled to anything. I will be registering with a new vet pronto.
Very friendly and helpful.  Despite an emergency taking place, still had time to deal with my pet.
Very patient and reassuring with my extremely nervous cocker spaniel. I appreciated the gentleness and how she spoke to my dog in such a caring manner.
Friendly welcoming staff at reception. Very little waiting. Highly competent vets.
A nice clean reception area. The staff are lovely.
Excellent professional service.
Very friendly, not rushing, answered all my questions &  gave me all advices that I need to know.

I called at the vets on Saturday morning on spec without an appointment as my dog was ill on Friday night. I only had a few minutes to wait before being seen by a vet.  My dog was prescribed medicines for which I was grateful.
All the staff are amazing and lovely! There’s a separate cat waiting area. The vets are always patient with my nervous cat even when he tries to get on top of the fridge.
My dog likes it and us to. The team has responded very quickly and I was very happy with the service.
Thank you

I have used this vets for my cats since they were kittens and I would highly recommend it. The reception staff are always very friendly and helpful and the waiting room environment is calm and comfortable. The vet always examines the cats thoroughly and is happy to discuss any concerns. I always have confidence in the advice and recommendations given.

A very friendly vets practice to use. They try very hard to give you an appointment with a vet that you prefer. Although it's a converted house where space is a premium, I like the way that they dedicate a quiet room away from the noise and smells of the main waiting room just for cats.

Friendly and professional staff . Vets are excellent and always calm with Tiddles.
Clean area and parking available

I changed my vets to Manor Vets, they are very caring and very informative. Keep you informed if they need surgery They love your pet and do there very best for them.
Staff are friendly,  and try to accommodate an appointment to your needs.
Good veterinary practice, we've been coming here for years. Very caring vets. Parking can difficult.

All staff really friendly and helpful. Excellent communication with the vets. A range of appointments times  to suit all. Great advice, great service. They truly treat you & your pet with respect and dignity.
Thank you

Fantastic vet practice! My dog is quite anxious at the vets and had a difficult moment during the appointment but the vet stayed calm and professional throughout and handled him really well. I really appreciate the reassurance and care given to both me and my dog. Thank you for your patience it means a lot
Quick and efficient and very friendly.

The 5 stars are given mainly for the Vet that I deal with rather than the Practice. Kathryn Tovey has taken very good care of my Yorky for seven years, ever since she put my previous dog to sleep. For the way Kat handled that dreadful issue I shall remain eternally grateful.

It was an emergancy and I was not registered with manor vets Lordwood rd. however the staff were fantastic looked after charlie and booked us in very quickly, the vet Kat was so calm and reassuring and was brilliant with myself and charlie. Can not thank them all enough,

I have always taken my four cats to the Harborne vets. My situation is complicated as my cats are living with another family member as there is a " no pet policy" where i reside. The vets and staff treat the cats and myself  with the upmost kindness and respect. My albino cat, Charlie gets rather excited ( zoomies!) if she thinks she is going to see the vets! .

Always welcoming, polite and nothing is too much trouble. Jackie is brilliant with Jenny our GSD, she is so engaging and very thorough, putting the welfare of the animal always first. 100% recommendation every time!

I came to this vets 4 years ago, whilst covid restrictions were still in place as my cat of 19 years needed to be put to sleep. This was one of the few local vets that allowed me to stay with my cat and hold her as this happened, and to this day I am still so touched and so grateful for the grace and kindness shown to me in this heart breaking moment of losing my best friend since I was 4 years old, by the wonderful vet - and I wish I could remember her name to thank her personally. Really great, compassionate service
It's Expensive for Emergency purposes for a vaccination and.other treatment
Helped me making my cat's life better ❤️ caring and professional

I had a mixed experience at this clinic. On the positive side, the vets here are extremely knowledgeable and took great care of my pet. You can tell they are professionals who truly understand their craft, and I felt confident in their abilities. The clinic itself is also very clean, which is always a good sign.
However, I was quite disappointed with the receptionist. Despite explaining our situation politely, she was very rude and showed no empathy whatsoever. It was frustrating because we were just trying to get some help, but her lack of courtesy left a bad impression. I hope the clinic addresses this aspect of customer service, as it really impacted the overall experience.

Very accommodating as they got me in the same day for my cat. Saw a lovely vet who was very knowledgeable and friendly.
Staff on reception were also very nice and helpful.
There was a nice friendly atmosphere. I would definitely recommend to friends and family.

No phone signsl, no payphone at reception, no WiFi access, no taxi phone. If you're not driving BE AWARE. People in the porchway or going out to the car park to get phone signal, having to temporarily leave their pets behind while doing so. Please get a payphone, a taxi phone or give WiFi access.
Very helpful, polite staff

Its like couple different vet using the same office but non of them taking responsibilities. They are not even following the treatment result in the next couple days. Not sure to trust for my lovely dog..
Unprofessional and rude stuff members
poor service red staff

Over the past week, I have been coming to this veterinary clinic hoping to find a solution to my dog’s problem. Instead, I have repeatedly been asked to pay for examinations and tests, with additional charges each time. After already paying £350 within a week, I was contacted and asked to return for a follow-up appointment.

When I arrived, a different vet saw us and immediately requested further tests and additional examination fees. When I explained the situation and the amount I had already paid, I was told that payment was still required.

When I became understandably upset, I was asked to leave the clinic—despite the fact that there was a snowstorm outside. My dog and I were left standing outside in those conditions, waiting in front of the door.

This experience felt extremely unprofessional and, frankly, inhumane. I came here expecting proper care and service for my pet, but instead I was met with a lack of empathy and support. İ definitely do not suggest
Brilliant service. Brought my 2 cats for a check up, both were shy at first but the vet is super nice and quickly checked them over.

Not a great outcome but the vet and the staff were great. Treated us & our pet with care and dignity. The vet listened to how we wanted to move forward.

Thank you

Not my usual vets but there were no appointments at my one. Was a bit of a treck to get there and was lucky enough to get a parking space out the front. The reception was nice a welcoming and had a separate waiting area for cats which was appreciated! Service was good, would definitely go again if mine wasn't available!
Excellent vets. Always close to appointment time. Always handled problems and routine check ups perfectly.
Brilliant  vets totally dedicated  to the pets been coming here for years
Friendly staff, highly skilful vets and nurses. Thank you so much for helping my little dog. I am very grateful.
Lovely place   lovely vets  very chilled and great atmosphere
Very friendly vet! Keeps my family's old dog ticking along!

First visit is fine. But for the second visit, we wait half hour for the treatment. After that we go around a bit and have bit lunch and find out the car been lock there in the customer car park. They never say the car park will be closed and lock at 12am Saturday. We have to wait until Monday to get car out. The nearby sho own say that happened more than once before. They wouldn't put sign or simply call us. That's stupid ever customer car park.
Kat continues to be exceptional and outstanding

To owner of the vets ..?

Please guys be careful whenever you’re parking the place because that’s manor vets owner the report to police all the vehicle who parked in there even that parking area is not for manor vets it’s free parking you allowed parking here whenever you want
I've used these vets for as long as I can remember and all my furries are treated as VIPets. The staff are patient, kind, and very helpful regarding my ADHD and my none existent attention span.
Couldn't get in at our usual branch but staff found us an appointment here. Staff were lovely ,we have re booked for the next appointment there .
Ist class Highly recommended very  friendly  atmosphere. Catherine is a first class vet and surgeon 10 out of 10.
Fantastic vets friendly and helpful
Very rude staff even women with silver Ford car
I had a great experience with Cat the vet at Harborne manor vet. She was honest and doesn't recommend things she doesn't think is really needed.
I like this clinic, it's a very professional, nice and reliable team.
Knowledgeable vet gave a new solution to an ongoing issue with my cats health that has worked right away, very happy with his input and reception staff were friendly and helpful
Another emergency appointment needed for my cat, excellent again with him.  Lordswood vets i would never go anywhere else.
Amazing service provided every single time visited. Highly recommended.

I would give a zero if possible. If you find injured wildlife NEVER bring them in. You think you do the best interest of the animal, but they’ll just grab it off you like you’re a poor stupid person, they will decide for you, you’ll have no say in the decision and they’ll just put it to sleep without giving people and the animal a chance. This is the worst experience ever. Awfully patronosong.
Very expensive and not transparent on prices.

ive only just started using this vets but im very happy to keep my dog here, he had a reactive moment and with him being bully type i expected judgement, instead we were given a room for him to calm down and everyone was very lovely. cat the vet we had was absolutely amazing, my boy gets a bit of anxiety and over excited in a new place but she was very patient with him and made him feel comfortable and took her time with him. there honestly is t a single complaint i could make other than maybe adding a larger waiting room for dogs who like their own space, other than that its a brilliant vets, would recommend.
They have a separate quite room for cats. Very clean environment.  Very friendly helpful staff
